measurement_scope: Gain-60 top-read PL spectra; historical photoKPFM Gaussian quantities retain their panel-specific definitions.
map_note: The current verified well map preserves the approved gain-60 source mapping. The historical display map differs at three unmatched background wells; historical gain-100 processed data are retained separately. All 13 nominal matches use consistent compositions.

rendering.figure4_overlaps: All 96 solid markers are retained at 91 recipe positions; column 12 is drawn behind column 11 at five shared positions.
rendering.figure5a_marker_area: 36 + 180 * (PL intensity / maximum PL intensity among 13 matches), in points squared; legend uses the same transform.
rendering.figureS5_errors: Archived delta_SP_se values linked by well ID and rechecked from raw Gaussian fitting.
rendering.assembly: Six separate plots; no title or panel-letter additions.

scientific_limits: No smoothing, interpolation, baseline subtraction, invented wavelengths, times or ADC ceiling.
Observed maxima use the 396 recorded centers from455 to850nm inclusive; all416 measured centers remain in the numeric archive.
No inter-gain count calibration or same-specimen/synchronized PL-photoKPFM interpretation.
No new PL component fits or structural phase assignments; no reuse of historical q values as gain-60 results.
